entities.summary: Mandatory Palestine, officially known as Palestine, was a British administrative territory between 1920 and 1948 in the region of Palestine. From 1922, under the terms of the League of Nations, it was the Mandate for Palestine. The territory was administered by the British, who deemed it unfit for self-governance.
